kernels.name: AITER unified_attention (Triton)

applesToApples: Both arg sets describe the SAME logical problem: a single sequence of 8192 tokens, paged K/V with block_size=16, causal masking, fp16, GQA 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128. The comparison is apples-to-apples; only the ABI layout differs — ours is batched [1, S, H, D] while AITER is varlen [total_q, H, D].
